subject: Community Listening Sessions Planning
overview: The subcommittee met to plan and coordinate community listening sessions across various Medford demographic groups and liaisons. Councilors assigned specific community groups to individual members and reviewed draft guidance on facilitating the sessions.

items.title: Open meeting law and document distribution
items.summary: The subcommittee clarified with City Clerk Adam Hurtubise that distributing facilitation materials through the clerk avoids open meeting law violations.

items.title: Listening session format and group assignments
items.summary: Councilors finalized outreach assignments across demographic groups and community liaisons, assigning lead councilors to handle scheduling and preliminary question design.

items.title: Review of listening session workshop document
items.summary: Councilor Callahan reviewed a guide on facilitating town halls, agreeing to produce an edited version focused on listening sessions rather than campaign strategy.
